statement: Wired IBEX rumble output 0x80 is 10 bytes: reportID0, type u8@1, intensity LE u16@2, left speed LE u16@4, left gain@6, right speed LE u16@7, right gain@9. SDL treats gains as i8 whereas kernel struct uses u8; bytes still agree for nonnegative gain. Pulse 0x81 is 8 bytes: ID@0, side u8@1, on_us u16 LE@2, off_us u16 LE@4, repeat_count u16 LE@6. Linux emits through hid_hw_output_report, SDL writes 0x80 through hidraw. No ACK/reply framing is specified in these sources. Linux:367-391,751-815; SDL structs:162-184 and driver:595-624.
